_comment: Verification pass of 2026-08-16: bracket table and the indexed non-refundable
credit amounts checked against CRA's published tables. THREE VALUES WERE
WRONG — the disability amount, the caregiver amount for children, and the
caregiver income threshold were all carrying the 2024 figures.
What remains unverified is mostly statutory rather than indexed: CPP and EI
figures, CCA rates, and the fixed statutory thresholds. Each needs a primary
source of its own; the indexation table does not cover them.

income_tax.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Last year tax rates and income brackets 2025 (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/tax-rates-brackets/last-year.html). Thresholds and rates both confirmed.

credit_rate.source: Non-refundable tax credits are valued at the lowest federal rate, which is the blended 14.5% for 2025. CONFIRM: CRA may direct 14% or 15% for specific credits in the 2025 transition year.

bpa_max.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

cwb_rate.source: Rate at which the CWB accrues on working income above the floor.

cwb_reduction_rate.source: The CWB is reduced by 15% of adjusted net income above the phase-out threshold. Derived and cross-checked: 1633/(37742-26855) and 2813/(49393-30639) both equal 0.15.

cwb_minimum_age.source: CWB requires the claimant to be 19 or older at year end, unless they have a spouse or a dependant child.

caregiver_adult_amount.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html). Previously an unconfirmed placeholder; the figure was right.

caregiver_adult_threshold.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html). CORRECTED: was 19666, which is the 2024 amount.

childcare_limit_under_7.source: Annual child care expense limit per child under 7 at year end. Form T778.

childcare_limit_7_to_16.source: Annual child care expense limit per child aged 7 to 16 at year end. Form T778.

childcare_limit_disabled.source: Annual child care expense limit per child eligible for the disability tax credit, any age. Form T778.

childcare_earned_income_num.source: Child care expenses are capped at two thirds of the claimant's earned income. Numerator, kept exact rather than as a rounded rate.

childcare_earned_income_den.source: Denominator of the two-thirds earned income cap on child care expenses.

eligible_dependant_max.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

caregiver_child_amount.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html). age_amount_max.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

age_amount_threshold.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

age_amount_clawback_rate.source: The age amount is reduced by 15% of net income above the threshold.

pension_income_max.source: Maximum pension income amount, T1 line 31400. Not indexed.

disability_amount.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html). CORRECTED: was 9872, which is the 2024 amount.

tuition_transfer_max.source: Maximum current-year tuition transferable to a spouse or parent, federal.

pension_split_max_rate.source: Up to 50% of eligible pension income may be allocated to a spouse under a joint election, form T1032.

spouse_amount_max.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

spouse_amount_min.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

medical_threshold_rate.source: Medical expenses are reduced by the lesser of 3% of net income and a fixed cap. T1 line 33199.

medical_threshold_cap.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

donation_first_tier.source: Charitable donations are credited at the lowest rate on the first $200 and a higher rate above it. T1 line 34900.

donation_rate_first.source: Federal credit rate on the first $200 of donations, 2025 (the blended lowest rate).

donation_rate_rest.source: Federal credit rate on donations above $200. NOTE: a 33% rate applies to the extent the donor has income taxed at 33%; that refinement is not modelled yet and will understate the credit for top-bracket donors.

canada_employment_amount.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/adjustment-personal-income-tax-benefit-amounts.html).

cpp_rate_enhanced.source: Enhanced (first additional) portion of the employee CPP rate. Deductible at line 22215 rather than creditable.

cpp_rate_base.source: Base portion of the employee CPP rate. Creditable at line 30800.

cpp_ympe.source: Year's maximum pensionable earnings, 2025. Caps how much self-employment income is pensionable once employment earnings are counted.

cpp_self_employed_multiple.source: A self-employed person pays both the employee and employer halves of CPP, so contributions are twice the employee rate. Schedule 8.

cpp_basic_exemption.source: CPP basic exemption, 2025. Earnings below this are not pensionable.

cpp_max_contribution.source: Maximum employee CPP contribution, 2025 (YMPE 71,300 less the 3,500 exemption, at 5.95%).

cpp2_max_contribution.source: Maximum employee second CPP contribution, 2025 (YAMPE 81,200 less YMPE 71,300, at 4%).

ei_min_insurable.source: Approximate floor below which EI premiums are refunded. Used only as a review heuristic, never in a calculation.

rrsp_rate.source: RRSP contribution room accrues at 18% of prior-year earned income. Used only as a review heuristic.

rrsp_annual_limit.source: RRSP dollar limit, 2025. Used only as a review heuristic.

cca_rate_class8.source: CCA rate, class 8 — furniture, fixtures and general equipment. Declining balance. Statutory, not indexed.

cca_rate_class10.source: CCA rate, class 10 — most motor vehicles. Declining balance. Class 10.1 passenger vehicles above the cost limit are NOT modelled and are treated differently.

cca_rate_class12.source: CCA rate, class 12 — tools under the cost threshold, computer software. Written off in full, subject to the first-year rule.

cca_rate_class50.source: CCA rate, class 50 — computer hardware and systems software. Declining balance.

cca_first_year_adjustment.source: The classic half-year rule: only half of net additions enter the base in the year of acquisition, so the adjustment is negative. CONFIRM whether the Accelerated Investment Incentive applies for this tax year — under AccII the sign flips to +0.5 (a 1.5x first-year base) for eligible property. Getting this wrong misstates every first-year claim.

vehicle_cost_limit.source: Passenger vehicle capital cost limit, class 10.1, 2025. UNVERIFIED — the limit moved to $37,000 for 2024 and is announced annually. Confirm before use.

cca_rate_class10_1.source: CCA rate, class 10.1 — passenger vehicles above the cost limit. Same rate as class 10, but each vehicle is its own pool and neither recapture nor a terminal loss ever arises.
